roadmap_gap_summary.roadmap_phase_goal: first loadable Zigux runtime modules with selftest hooks and runtime module lifecycle parity
roadmap_gap_summary.missing_capability: shared runtime substrate that can turn the bounded atomic64 loader scaffold into a real loadable module path
roadmap_gap_summary.blocked_deliverable: loadable Phase 9 runtime atomic64 pilot module parity
roadmap_gap_summary.next_gate: keep the loader scaffold and shared-request lifecycle proof explicit until the shared runtime loader substrate can consume the handoff plan

gaps.why_now: A bounded loader scaffold keeps the entry and exit symbol names, `toSharedLoadPlan()` plus `runtime_loader.prepareRequest()`, and shared-request lifecycle proofs reviewable without implying live runtime registration parity.
The roadmap's full runtime module lifecycle parity still depends on shared runtime-loader support before any honest claim of live atomic64 module binding.
